title: The admission wait had no real deadline: a hung read blocked it, and an admission read after the deadline passed
resolution: Each read runs in the background and is killed at the deadline; no read starts after it, and a late admission is a timeout; tests cover both.

title: A bound with a leading zero was read as octal, so 08 failed and 010 meant 8 seconds
resolution: The bound is converted in base 10; tests cover 08 and 010.

title: The record and the tasks still called make verify, the Docker gate, and the integration checks not run
resolution: The coordinator's runs on 431d1ddf are recorded in their own section and the tasks ticked; the author checks stay as they ran.

title: The late admission test was killed at the bound and never reached the late-decision check
resolution: Renamed to assert the kill; a new test slows node so the read ends in time and the decision after the bound.

title: A bound of 0 skipped the loop, so reading the absent log failed with status 1 and left the temporary directory
resolution: A zero bound is a usage error, the log exists before the loop, and an EXIT trap of the subshell removes the directory.

title: The spec and guide used refused read without defining it
resolution: A new requirement and the guide say which read failures are retried and which fail at once.

title: Design D4 cited a stale line for the wait function
resolution: The citation names the function's current line.

title: Tasks for make verify and the Docker gate were ticked while their reruns were pending
resolution: They name the revision they ran on, and a new unticked task tracks the final reruns.

title: The waiting exit status was a bare 3 in four places, repeating the helper's constant
resolution: A named shell constant with a comment that points to the helper's WAITING.
